info.title: E3 HR – EOS integration proposal
info.description: DESIGN ONLY: these endpoints are not implemented or deployed. EOS details are pending. All credentials are bound to one integration and organization; explicit activation scope applies to every object lookup and aggregate. Unknown or unauthorized resources return 404. Permission extensions document required grants; the implementation must enforce them.
